name: duopore-public-supplied-rate-currency-convert
description: Convert money amounts using an exchange rate you choose, with clear rounding.
keywords: convert at a rate you enter

interface.shortDescription: Convert at a rate you enter
interface.longDescription: Convert money amounts using an exchange rate you choose, with clear rounding. Enter the amounts and the rate as target currency units for one source currency unit. Choose how many decimal places to keep. See the converted amounts and the rate used. The app does not fetch live exchange rates or include bank fees.
capabilities: Convert at a rate you enter
defaultPrompt: Convert these amounts using the exchange rate I provide.
Show the converted totals and rounding at this rate.

positive.prompt: Use Supplied Rate Currency Convert with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"sourceCurrency":"USD","targetCurrency":"THB","rate":35.5,"decimals":2,"amounts":[{"recordId":"001","sourceAmount":10},{"recordId":"002","sourceAmount":-2}]}
